messages:
Alex: FYI noticed a p99 spike on the latency dashboard for service=api-realtime after yesterday's routing policy change. p50/p95 look normal, p99 up ~35%. endpoint view points to /v1/stream only. anyone seen this?
Maria: which Console view/filter? endpoints percentiles or the legacy endpoint page? can you paste the filters? :mag_right:
Alex: Console -> Observability -> Latency -> Endpoints, filtered region=us-east, model=redwood-13b, endpoint=/v1/stream. Link: https://console/redwood/latency?endpoint=%2Fv1%2Fstream
Dan: likely fallback behavior. the routing tweak reduced primary pool weight so a small fraction started hitting pool:reserved-legacy which has higher tail latency. that can spike p99 while leaving p50/p95 almost unchanged.
Olivia: infra logs show quota_exceeded events around 03:12 UTC that triggered fallback for tenant=acme-co. snippet: 
```
{"time":"2026-02-18T03:12:08Z","tenant":"acme-co","route":"api-realtime","decision":"fallback","reason":"quota_exceeded","target":"pool:reserved-legacy"}
```
Jeff: important question: are percentiles in the Console computed by merging tdigests from shards or by merging per-origin percentiles? merging per-origin percentiles is wrong for tails.
Maria: backend merges tdigests from each shard and extracts percentiles, so math is correct. but the UI collapses sample_origin info by default which makes it look like a single-service regression.
Alex: so the calculation is fine, UX is misleading. users see a p99 jump without context and assume regressions.
Dan: another wrinkle: sampling fractions differ by route and origin. some routes only sample 1/20 traces. if the legacy pool briefly had a higher sample fraction that minute it can distort p99. we should surface sample_count with percentiles.
Jeff: propose quick and medium fixes: 1) immediate: show sample_count and a small origin badge in percentile hover for endpoints; 2) medium: add an inline explanation that percentiles are computed from merged tdigests and recommend drilling down by sample_origin for tail issues.
Olivia: I can do a small PR to add sample_count and origin breakdown link in the hover tooltip. ETA today EOD for a small patch.
infra-bot: route-policy-service v2.4 deployed by @deploy-bot at 2026-02-18T02:58:43Z (sha: b7a9c3e) :rocket:
Maria: can we also add a one-click drilldown that reruns the percentile query partitioned by sample_origin? that'll save debugging loops.
Olivia: yep will include the drilldown link in the PR.
Alex: plan: Olivia lands PR for tooltip + drilldown, Dan to verify sampling fractions and counts for 03:10-03:20 UTC, Jeff to draft small FAQ blurb explaining merge semantics for Console. I'll notify oncall and CS if customers ask. :thumbsup:
Jeff: happy to draft the blurb. ping when you want it posted.
Maria: filing a short dashboard incident note for CS with the root-cause/mitigation steps.
Alex: closing when PR merges and we confirm tail reduces after routing weight adjustment. thanks team. :wave:
